title: Select a reading unit
subtitle: Choose a paragraph-sized unit before beginning a study.
overview: Independent reading improves when the unit has a coherent beginning, development, and ending. Do not start in the middle of a paragraph because a verse number looks convenient.
Use connectors, changes of speaker, repeated vocabulary, and concluding inference to locate a manageable reading unit.

sections.title: Boundary clues
rows: A new setting, address, topic, or main assertion begins.
Connectors and repetition sustain the unit.
A summary, response, result, or new topic marks a boundary.
Choose enough text to see the argument, not only one phrase.

items.en: Therefore we do not lose heart: likely a new inferential unit.

items.grc: διὰ τοῦτο κάμπτω τὰ γόνατά μου πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.
items.en: For this reason I bow my knees before the Father: a new prayer unit begins.
